displayName.text: Diamond Spa For Men - En el Poblado Medellín

text.text: This place was really good, I had a couple massages with my wife, and a facial. Camila was our person and she was amazing. Very caring and delicate with my wife’s massage as well as our facial. This place is really good.
Make sure you pay before you start. They say one price then at the end tells you a complete other price to get more money. I would avoid this place and don’t believe the other reviews as legitimate

I absolutely love this spa.
Very Clean, relaxing. Staff is very competent . My therapist Camila was exceptional, very professional, attentive, patient. I highly recommend. Thx Camila. I will be back
Very good and professional massage. Will come again after a sport session

Great spa in El Poblado for relaxing massages. I really liked the atmosphere and the attention was excellent. They also offered me a delicious Nespresso coffee. Very good experience, I’ll definitely come back.
